resources.string: Open-source Android network analysis and troubleshooting toolbox
Supported test history, saved report snapshots, and managed device profiles are stored locally. Exported copies and system device transfers are separate.

LinkBeacon does not automatically upload diagnostic reports, history, or device profiles to LanYun Studio servers. Tests make necessary requests to selected targets, Android DNS resolvers, public probes, or local devices; these requests leave your device.
You can use the core features without an account.

Android requires precise location permission and enabled Location Services for nearby Wi-Fi observations. SSIDs and BSSIDs can be sensitive and location-related. LinkBeacon does not schedule background Wi-Fi scans.
Copy, PDF export, and sharing happen at your request. Review reports before sharing: recipient apps and document providers may retain or upload their own copies.
